title: faaaaa
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.theme: 'Great suckening' of capital by AI fundraising
macro_themes.view: Massive AI capital raises (OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, Meta, Oracle) suck money out of stocks and weigh on the market until companies pass peak negative cash flow.
He thinks yields peaked around 5.27% and are now falling as a flight to safety, making bonds and rate-sensitive plays attractive.
Iran tensions, the election and next week's Fed meeting create fear; these are times to buy, and he expects a rally after the midterms.

macro_themes.theme: Rates to zero and oil to $40 in 2030s
macro_themes.view: AI-driven deflation plus stimulus will bring rates back to zero by ~2032-33, oil back to $40 and booming real estate.

calls.condition: Buy only once price is in the 700-707 box, not between 707 and 715.
calls.reason: 700-707 box is where September peak fear was; AI earnings beats with collapsing forward P/E create opportunity; expects post-midterm rally.
calls.quote: You buy when we break through and you're between 700 and 707. That's the buy zone right here

calls.reason: Yields peaked near 5.27 and are falling on flight to safety; long term AI deflation plus money printing take rates to zero by 2032-33.
calls.quote: I think we just hit peak yields

calls.reason: Captures ~$690B of AI capex; trades at roughly 0.58 PEG.
